text: {"score":3,"justification":"Core numbers match the card (13.5%, 2.7%, 10.71, z 1.41, 45 documented, 19 documented 99215s, 1 below billed). The pattern is cautious and the next steps are concrete. But several claims are unsupported or wrong: 'roughly three times the all-provider rate in every condition-count group' is loose (ratios range from about 2.4x to 3.1x), and 'every complexity group' is overstated. Cited claims C0008921, C0008927 and C0008980 do not appear on the card, and the 'repeated-time entries' and 'duplicate notes' statements have no support. The 17% comparison rate, the note-check percentages and the stated 51% cannot be verified from the card. The leaning is stated as 'inconclusive' but the rationale says the claims 'point toward upcoding'. The headline says 'largely supports' while only one 99215 was unsupported; that is fair but the sample is small.","problems":["Cites claims C0008921, C0008927, C0008980 that are not in the evidence card","Unmatched number '7' (7% late) and other note-check percentages not verifiable on the card","'Roughly three times in every condition-count group' is imprecise (ratios about 2.4x–3.1x)","'Repeated-time entries' and 'duplicate notes' claims are unsupported by the card","The statement that C0009169 'did' come from the low-complexity group is true, but the low-complexity claims cited for example (UTI, abdominal pain, follow-up) are only partly accurate; C0009308 is Z09, and the 'follow-up' wording is a stretch","Mixed signals: 'points toward upcoding' alongside an inconclusive leaning; a long, dense rationale","Comparison rate 17% is from the card's all-provider rate for 99215, but it is presented as 'comparison providers' without clarification"]}
